summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by UBS Group AG and UBS AG reporting their second quarter 2026 financial results. The filing contains presentation materials related to the quarterly earnings, with no mention of any merger, acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or abrupt management change. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report for a foreign private issuer, consisting of standard financial disclosures and investor materials. As it does not describe a special situation event but rather a periodic financial update, it falls outside the defined special-situations categories.
